metaTitle: Contact messages | Admin | PR Per Hour
metaDescription: Review and manage contact form submissions for PR Per Hour administrators.
detailMetaTitleFallback: Contact message details | Admin | PR Per Hour
detailMetaDescription: Review a contact message, update its status, or soft-delete it.
lead: Review inbound contact form submissions. Status tracking only — no reply or email sending from this UI.
scopeBody: Update status or soft-delete messages. Outbound email, replies, attachments, and the public contact form are not part of this screen.
searchHint: Matches name, email, phone, organization, and message text.
name: Name
detailLead: Message text is shown as plain text. Status “replied” is operational tracking only — this UI does not send email.
statusDialogDescription: Current status: {{current}}. Choose any documented status. No email is sent.
softDeleteNote: This is a soft delete. The message leaves the admin list and details. Restore is not available in this UI.
emptyDescription: When visitors submit the contact form, messages will appear here.
filteredEmptyDescription: No messages match these filters. Reset filters to see all messages.
